name: approval_interpreter_family
notes: Traced C copy of approval_wrappers.c::appr_u_interpreter_family vs LIVE tools/approval.py::_interpreter_family regex ladder (11 inputs, all families + miss). KNOWN DIVERGENCE (avoided here): C matches by case-sensitive prefix/strcmp while LIVE fullmatches a regex on basename.lower(), so uppercase basenames ('Python3') and over-broad prefixes ('py2', 'python4', 'pythonx') would classify differently — real normalization gap worth a follow-up port fix.
